# TIKA-4797 manual migration overlay (core scope, adjudicated + confirmed 2026-07-28)
# The moves/removals the field-identity join could NOT auto-bridge. Everything else auto-renames.
#   v4 = DROPPED: 4.x no longer emits it; removed on ingest, not bridgeable.
#   EGRESS_ONLY: applied only V4_TO_V3 (several v4 keys may share one v3 spelling; ingest would
#   be ambiguous or would mis-map same-named keys from other sources, so ingest ignores the row).
# (tk:internal-path) = folderPath + "/" + item-name on each mail item -> the folder path became the
# full item path, a SUPERSET. Not a 1:1 value, so the key-rename bridge can't reproduce the folder-only
# value; document "folder path now part of tk:internal-path". Not bridgeable as a rename.
# pre-4.0.0; tk:content-handler-type covers the use case with a different value shape (enum name,
# not handler simple class name), so the 3.x key is not remapped rather than remapped-wrong.
# RTF embedded-object fields: 4.x renamed the Java fields EMB_* -> EMBEDDED_* AND the keys
# rtf_meta:emb_* -> rtf:embedded-*, so field-identity can't bridge them. Clean renames (targets
# verified present in the 4.x closed set); fuzzy suggested each correctly.
# TikaCoreProperties fields that were bare String constants (not Property) in 3.x, so the 3.x field
# table -- which only captures static Property fields -- never recorded them; field-identity can't
# join what was never a field of that type. Verified against the 3.3.2 tag: both keys shipped bare,
# TIKA-4816 rename batch (post stage-5a). These fields are declared outside org.apache.tika.metadata
# (parser modules), so the field-identity join -- core-scoped by design (see
# MigrationTableGenerator's javadoc) -- can never auto-detect them; every row here is adjudicated.
# The unbounded-suffix families in this same batch (GeoParser Optional_/geotopic:alt-, Ogg streams-/
# -- they're prefix rules in LegacyKeyMigrationFilter instead (flat rows can't express an
# GeoParser (tika-parser-nlp-module): the best-match location's fixed fields. geo: -> geotopic:
# (TIKA-4816 rename batch) to cleanly separate from the W3C Geo Vocabulary's geo: namespace.
# TEIDOMParser (tika-parser-nlp-module): namespaced under grobid:tei: + kebab-case. The v3
# spellings are grobid:header_<Field> -- 3.3.2 GrobidRESTParser.java:107 re-keyed TEIDOMParser's
# scratch-Metadata bare names under "grobid:header_" before they reached parse output, so the bare
# names (Title, Abstract, ...) never appeared in any release's output and must NOT be v3 rows
# (bare generic words would mis-map unrelated 3.x keys on ingest). The re-keying step is retired
# in 4.x: TEIDOMParser's grobid:tei:* keys are final.
# elsewhere in the module (the iworks: -> iwork: prefix rename itself is a
# LegacyKeyMigrationFilter prefix rule, not a flat row -- open family).
# IDML/MIF (tika-parser-miscoffice-module; interfaces relocated into tika-core this batch).
# unified onto the pre-existing curated Audio.CHANNELS/Audio.BITS_PER_SAMPLE; AudioParser's bare
# "encoding" promoted to a new curated Audio constant; MidiParser's MIDI-sequence fields namespaced.
# Mp3Parser's bare "version" (MPEG version/layer string) and OggAudioParser's bare "version"
# (CODEC_VERSION, e.g. "Theora 3.2.1") both used the identical bare key "version" pre-batch and
# now diverge to mp3:version vs ogg:codec-version. A flat v3->v4 row can't disambiguate by source
# parser on ingest, so ingest stays unbridged -- but egress (V4_TO_V3, the BWC direction) is
# unambiguous per 4.x key, so both restore the 3.x bare spelling as EGRESS_ONLY rows.
# GDALParser (tika-parser-scientific-module): gdalinfo's small fixed-vocabulary patterns, now
# namespaced to gdal: + kebab-case (previously bare, matching gdalinfo's own literal output text --
# that literal text as a separate label parameter so the rename doesn't break the match).
# "File-Type-Description" from both parsers (HDFParser.java:106 / NetCDFParser.java:87 at the
# 3.3.2 tag -- the prefixed spellings only ever existed on unreleased 4.x main). Bare-and-shared
# means ingest can't disambiguate (same shape as bare "version" above), so these are EGRESS_ONLY:
# each 4.x key restores the bare 3.x spelling on egress; ingest passes the bare key through.
# The rows below were found by MetadataChangesAdocDriftTest (TIKA-4816), not by the original
# audit that seeded this file: each is a real 3.x key declared outside org.apache.tika.metadata
# (parser modules), so -- same as the GeoParser/TEIDOMParser/GDAL rows above -- field-identity
# can't auto-bridge it. Verified against the 3.3.2 tag.
# PDFBoxRenderer (tika-parser-pdf-module): these two timing fields moved onto the core Rendering
# class this batch, so the 3.x side (still declared on PDFBoxRenderer, non-core) is out of the
# join's core-only scope even though the key text itself is unchanged.
# TikaCoreProperties.EMBEDDED_STORAGE_CLASS_ID: a bare String constant in 3.x (not a Property, so
# missing from the field table like resourceName/embeddedRelationshipId above), moved onto Office
# 35 ad hoc PascalCase/space-delimited coinages (several with a stray trailing space, one with a
# trailing hyphen, one with a trailing "-->", and one with an upstream typo -- AccessContraints)
# get honest iso19115: + kebab-case spellings. Not core-declared in the 3.x snapshot (the class
# didn't exist as a curated Property source until this batch), so field-identity can't auto-bridge
# any of these -- every row here is adjudicated. Old spellings copied character-exact from the
# pre-rename ISO19115.java; trailing spaces are meaningful and preserved by this row (v3 is taken
# Deleted-key adjudications (TIKA-4816 round-3 review: keys removed in 4.x that the field-identity
# join silently produced nothing for -- see MigrationCompletenessTest, which now fails on any
# OfficeOpenXMLCore.SUBJECT (cp:subject) was a COMPOSITE that also wrote DublinCore.SUBJECT, so
# every 3.x output carrying cp:subject carries the same value under dc:subject; dropping on ingest
# is pure dedup, and dc:subject survives unchanged.
# IPTC.DIGITAL_SOURCE_FILE_TYPE was a misspelled 3.x alias no parser ever wrote (declaration-only;
# the correctly-spelled Iptc4xmpExt:DigitalSourceType survives in 4.x). Nothing to bridge.
# JackcessParser.MDB_PW: bare "Password" -> mdb:password. EGRESS_ONLY: rewriting every bare
# "Password" key on ingest would mis-map same-named keys from non-Access sources.
# ParserUtils' 3.x exception keys, found by MigrationCompletenessTest's first run: the fields
# moved onto TikaCoreProperties (and the keys kebab-cased), so the core-only field-identity join
# never saw them. Unambiguous both-way renames.
# ClimateForecast (chunk-4 ruling, 2026-08-13): the CF convention's 15 keys keep their verbatim
# suffixes but move under cf: -- bare generic tokens (comment, source, history) collided
# indistinguishably in the global keyspace. Distinctive CF-specific spellings bridge both ways;
# generic English tokens are EGRESS_ONLY (rewriting every bare "comment" on ingest would
# mis-map same-named keys from non-CF sources). The field-identity join can't see any of these:
# the constants moved interfaces (ClimateForcast -> ClimateForecast) AND renamed.
